rv.q: Although the set could hardly be skimpier...this is impro with the full accent on pro: top-dollar amusement that doesn’t let up from frisky, low-key start to standing ovation-inducing finish.
At the finale everyone was clapping and singing along and I left humming happily.
The seemingly effortless synergy between the performers is what makes this so appealing.
The book, music and lyrics may not be hugely sophisticated but the choruses are catchy.
But it is, above all, a tremendously good time, and when it clicks, it’s absolutely magical.

cn.t: Critics praise this Olivier-winning improv musical for its impressive quick-thinking cast and catchy choruses, though note the spontaneously created material lacks sophistication.
